themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents designed to perform complex research tasks, collaborate, and operate autonomously in research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with writing, reviewing, and debugging code, including security aspects.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms and tools used to facilitate and enhance various research activities.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Deals with AI applications that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for quick understanding.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, and the overall labor market, including potential displacement and adaptation.

themes.name: AI design & research
themes.description: Covers AI's role in the design process, from ideation and prototyping to applying research-backed best practices.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Focuses on AI's ability to analyze qualitative data, such as customer feedback or reviews, to understand sentiment and emotions.

themes.name: AI recruitment
themes.description: Details AI applications in hiring, including resume screening, interview analysis, and candidate assessment.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Encompasses AI tools and methodologies used to evaluate and improve the usability of products and services.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Addresses the creation and use of AI-generated personas or data that mimic human users for research and testing purposes.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
